technology_name: Programmable Implantable Micro Infusion Pump for Targeted Drug Delivery
institution: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST)
problem_solved: Controlled and targeted delivery of therapeutic fluids to specific regions of the body.
description: This implantable micro infusion pump is a programmable device designed to deliver bolus or basal doses of fluids to targeted regions of the body, including the peritoneal cavity and spinal cord. The system supports multiple flow and discharge modes, enabling controlled administration based on therapeutic requirements.
applications:
Hospitals and specialty healthcare centers providing targeted drug therapies
Medical device manufacturers developing implantable therapeutic systems
Oncology, pain management, neurology, and critical care treatment facilities
Biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies working on controlled drug delivery solutions
Research institutions and biomedical engineering organizations developing advanced implantable medical technologies
